metadata.description: Nitin's personal Claude Code plugins: reusable skill packs for engineering, product, daily workflow, note capture, and writing.

plugins.name: eng
plugins.description: Plan-to-ship engineering pipeline. Six composable skills (scope, grill, eng-review, tdd, execute, ship) plus an orchestrator (eng-flow), each a single pass over a shared markdown doc in the project's .plan folder, with full and express tracks. Standalone skills: research, migrate, resolve-conflicts, conventions (house-style cache every other skill reads), understand, debug, spike, adr, refactor, backfill-tests, pr-walkthrough, pr-review, review.

plugins.name: product
plugins.description: Product-thinking skills. Write staff-level PRDs, slice them into testable user stories, or run /product-flow to take an idea through both and hand off to eng's /scope. Output lands in .plan/<feature>/ where /scope reads it directly.

plugins.name: studio
plugins.description: Plan a new product end to end before any code: /idea runs office hours, /niche researches the category into an interface thesis, /founder-review settles scope, /brand finds a free name and draws the icon, /design-system locks one distinctive design system as tokens, /design-variants and /mockups design every screen as HTML, /design-review scores it and checks drift, /tech-plan fixes the stack, architecture and code rules. /studio-flow runs them in order.

plugins.name: work
plugins.description: The work day loop, one Obsidian note per day. /daily plans the day into a task list from calendar, mail, Slack, Jira and meeting notes, /standup prints a speakable update, /shutdown closes the day from real evidence and commits the vault, /weekly reviews the week. The notes folder comes from 99 Meta/Paths.md in the vault.

plugins.name: productivity
plugins.description: Workflow helpers: /ask (the router over every skill in this marketplace), catchup, caveman, handoff, stress-test. The daily work loop moved to the work plugin, and studying is in learn.

plugins.name: learn
plugins.description: A daily study loop for DSA, system design and reading. /study plans today's problems, reading and system design from your tracker, review queue and bookmarks. /study-shutdown logs what you did, schedules problems to come back, moves your reading bookmark and hands what you learned to /note.

plugins.name: brain
plugins.description: Second-brain capture for an Obsidian vault: dump what you just learned by voice or text and /note places it in the right learning folder, writes it up in your own note-taking voice (not AI voice), wires up bidirectional wikilinks, and updates the index hub. Vault located via $OBSIDIAN_VAULT or by finding .obsidian/, learning folder from 99 Meta/Paths.md.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Plain, direct English for everything Claude writes, plus the tools to write skills. /unslop rewrites or audits text that reads like AI wrote it, /skill authors new skills to this repo's standard, and a SessionStart hook keeps the house style live in every session.
